description: This file defines FastAPI routes for managing user files in a web application. It includes endpoints for listing, uploading, and deleting files, with integrations to Supabase for storage and metadata management. It also enforces file type and size restrictions.

methods.name: Client get_supabase()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase client using environment variables.

methods.name: str _ext(name: str)
methods.description: Extracts the file extension from a filename.

methods.name: list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists files associated with the current user, optionally filtered by session_id.

methods.name: upload_file( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Handles uploading a file, validating its extension and size, storing it in Supabase Storage, and inserting metadata.

methods.name: delete_file(file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a specific file owned by the current user from storage and metadata database.

methods.name: delete_session_file(session_id: str, file_id: str, user=Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Deletes a file associated with a particular session, verifying ownership.

ctags.name: list_files
ctags.pattern: /^def list_files(session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID")/
ctags.signature: (session_id: Optional[str] = Query(None, description="Filter files by session ID"), user=Depends(get_current_user))

ctags.signature: ( session_id: str = Form(..., description="Target session ID"), upload: UploadFile = File(..., description="File to upload (.docx, .pdf, .txt, .xlsx)"), user=Depends(get_current_user), )
